prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single isolated MMORPG currency inventory icon for An Thanh, a restrained medieval fantasy pixel-art game. Draw authentic low-resolution pixel art intended for a 32x32 native sprite, shown enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels. Flat 2D HUD asset, not an isometric world object. Deliberately chunky logical pixel grid, about 4 shades per material, dark moss-charcoal one-logical-pixel outline, crisp hard stepped edges, upper-left lighting, medium detail. Exactly ONE centered object, occupies about 26x26 logical pixels leaving at least 2 logical pixels transparent margin. True transparent background/alpha, no checkerboard drawn into image. No text, digits, labels, frame, rarity border, floor, shadow on a floor, scenery, sparkles, blur, gradients, smooth vector shapes, tiny filigree, or photorealistic rendering. Keep silhouette simple and readable at 32 pixels. Prefer output actual 32x32 RGBA if possible; otherwise preserve the appearance of an enlarged 32x32 pixel sprite. Subject: Tinh Thach, one asymmetrical upright six-facet cyan crystal, slightly tilted, one clear broad front facet and a short smaller side facet. Not a cluster of multiple gems. Palette pale cyan highlight, #71D1DC cyan main plane, muted teal side plane, deep blue-green shadow. Modest single highlight, no radiating glow. Taller angular silhouette. No ornament or metal socket.
